excluded.feature_angle_deg: the same 30 degrees on every fingerprint
excluded.lattice_base_size_m: null on every non-commensurate body; the commensurate feature carries it
excluded.patches: patch names are the generator's; every tuning fingerprint has one patch

null_policy.why: features.py leaves curvature null when no triangle is curved (a box); a plane's radius is infinite, so it takes the flattest value the clip allows
null when no inner tangent ball meets a facing wall: there is no thin section, so the thickness is taken as the body's own largest extent
null when no outer tangent ball meets a second wall (a single body): the gap is taken as ten body extents

surrogate.fold: the fold model that leaves the geometry's fold out (optimise.fold_of, AUT-09's cross-fit); the hook deploys the train-part model
